senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (Cartago, Carthago, -inis) Carthage (rebuilt under the Roman empire), on the northern coast of Africa.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 110a:4">Men. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>מצור ועד ק׳ מכירין וכ׳</he> from Tyre to Carthage they know (respect the past history of) Israel and their Father in heaven, but from Tyre westward and from Carthage eastward they do not know &c.; Is. 316.
